name: Northwest ComicCon
blurb: A one-day vintage and Golden/Silver Age comic book and original-art dealer show at the DoubleTree Portland, with comic creator guests.

editions.evidence: Portland subpage text: 'Northwest ComicCon – Portland, OR Saturday, October 17th, 2026 • 11:00 am – 5:00 pm DoubleTree by Hilton – Portland, 1000 NE Multnomah, Portland, OR 97232'

notes: Brand runs two shows (Bellevue Sep 19 2026 and Portland Oct 17 2026) under northwestcomiccon.com; per the multi-city rule this file covers only the Portland edition (batch place = Portland, OR), using https://northwestcomiccon.com/Portland/Index.aspx rather than the shared root URL. Organizer inferred from the site's own social links (facebook.com/terrysvintagecomics, whatnot.com/user/terrysoldschoolcomics, x.com/TerrysOldSchool). Guests page shows only a name + 2 art-sample images per guest, no bio text; Known-for for Aaron Lopresti confirmed via a web search (Wonder Woman, Justice League, DC), the other two inferred directly from the work-sample filenames shown on the card (randy_asm.jpg/Spidy Carnage Sketch; CW_PREDCOVER1/cw_DrStrange) plus Chris Warner's own Dark Horse bio confirmed separately on another con's guest page.
